top_stories.title: IAM for AI agents: A Practical Enterprise Framework
top_stories.summary: This article presents a practical enterprise framework for applying IAM principles to AI agents, covering authentication, authorization, and delegated authority for agentic systems. The guide addresses gaps in conventional provisioning approaches and outlines components for governing AI agent identity, including runtime verification of agent behavior.

top_stories.title: JADEPUFFER-Linked Attackers Used Compromised Service Principals to Delete Azure Resources
top_stories.summary: A threat actor tracked as JADEPUFFER (Storm-3168) used compromised Azure service principals to conduct destructive operations within a Microsoft Azure environment over an 18-hour period in early June 2026. The attack involved abusing service principals—a core identity and access construct in Azure—to delete resources, representing an evolution in the threat actor's tactics.

top_stories.title: Okta builds shared architecture for agent runtime security
top_stories.summary: Okta has transformed its agent runtime security framework into a multivendor reference architecture through the Blueprint Alliance. The initiative establishes shared controls across the technology stack to address identity and security challenges as enterprises deploy AI agents in production environments.

top_stories.title: Storm-3168: Agentic-driven cloud attacks using compromised service principals
top_stories.summary: Microsoft has detailed attack activity by Storm-3168 (linked to JADEPUFFER) targeting Azure environments through compromised service principals, involving reconnaissance, resource deletion, and credential access. The report includes defender guidance focused on protecting Azure service principals, which are a core identity and access management construct in cloud environments.

top_stories.title: Dual NetScaler Zero-Days Trigger Chaos for Citrix Customers
top_stories.summary: Citrix disclosed two critical zero-day vulnerabilities affecting NetScaler (formerly Citrix ADC and Gateway) products in their default configurations. The flaws effectively grant attackers unauthorized access to customer networks, functioning as authentication and access bypasses with broad impact across Citrix's customer base.

news.title: Genea brings AI agents to access control with role-based permissions
news.summary: Genea has launched Genea MCP, a Model Context Protocol server that connects AI agents to its physical access control platform using role-based permissions. The product allows natural language commands to handle tasks like onboarding new hires, provisioning contractors, and managing physical access points.

news.title: Hackers exploit Citrix NetScaler zero-day to deploy web shells
news.summary: Attackers exploited a Citrix NetScaler zero-day vulnerability (CVE-2026-88772) to deploy web shells and tunneling malware on compromised systems. The attack chain included gaining root access, stealing credentials, and moving laterally into internal networks.

news.title: Catch threats before they escalate with real-time Identity Telemetry
news.summary: tenfold Software published content advocating for real-time identity telemetry as a complement to traditional identity governance and periodic access reviews. The piece argues that continuous monitoring of identity activity enables security teams to detect and investigate suspicious behavior before it escalates into a breach.

news.title: French Tax Data Theft Using Stolen Staff Passwords Went Undetected for Seven Weeks
news.summary: An attacker used stolen employee credentials to exfiltrate tax data on hundreds of thousands of French taxpayers and businesses from the national tax administration over a seven-week period without detection. France's cybersecurity agency ANSSI attributed the breach's success to weak security controls, with the attack relying solely on compromised staff passwords rather than sophisticated techniques.

news.title: Official MCP Python SDK Flaw Can Let Malicious Servers Steal OAuth Credentials
news.summary: A vulnerability in the official MCP Python SDK allowed malicious servers to steal OAuth credentials including client secrets, authorization codes, and PKCE proof keys by redirecting them to attacker-controlled token endpoints. The flaw has been patched in version 1.30.0 of the SDK.

news.title: AI agent identity security demands layered defenses, Omdia says
news.summary: Omdia released analysis on AI agent identity security, arguing that layered defenses are needed to protect a growing class of machine identities. The report references consolidation trends in the identity security market, including activity from Palo Alto Networks, CyberArk, and Okta.

news.title: AI Agents Are Privileged Users; Who Is Auditing Their Access?
news.summary: The article examines how autonomous AI agents are operating with broad privileged access within enterprises, drawing parallels to insider threat risks. The piece raises questions about auditing and governance frameworks for AI agent access, intersecting with PAM, identity governance, and access management disciplines.

news.title: JadePuffer AI Actor Compromises Azure Tenant in Destructive Cloud Attack
news.summary: A threat actor dubbed "JadePuffer" compromised an Azure tenant and conducted a destructive attack that deleted cloud-based storage, applications, and databases. The actor is believed to have used exposed credentials to gain initial access, making this directly relevant to cloud identity and access management security.

news.title: Webinar: How to Govern AI Agents, Reduce Excessive Access, and Control Shadow AI
news.summary: A webinar is being promoted addressing the governance of AI agents in enterprise environments, citing Okta's Global CISO Insights 2026 report. The content focuses on reducing excessive access, controlling shadow AI, and applying identity controls to AI agents operating across business systems.

news.title: CISA Says Attackers Are Exploiting Two Critical Citrix NetScaler Flaws Globally
news.summary: CISA added two critical Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog due to active global exploitation. The flaws affect NetScaler Gateway, which is widely used for remote access and authentication, with one vulnerability (CVE-2026-88771, CVSS 9.5) allowing unauthenticated attackers to exploit improper input validation.

news.title: 1Password ties AI agent access to individual tasks
news.summary: 1Password is implementing task-scoped access controls for AI agents, tying credential access to individual tasks rather than persistent sessions. The approach addresses the identity attribution challenge posed by AI agents, which exhibit characteristics of both human and machine users and complicate audit logging and access governance.

news.title: Oktane 2026: The industry is ready to talk about AI kill switches | Computer Weekly
news.summary: At Okta's Oktane 2026 conference, security leaders discussed the concept of AI kill switches as a mechanism to terminate out-of-control AI agents. The conversation reflects growing industry focus on controlling and governing non-human/AI identities within IAM frameworks.

news.title: AI Accounts Are Becoming the New Target for Infostealers
news.summary: SOCRadar analyzed stealer log data from the past 90 days and found 482 companies with exposed AI accounts, credentials, sessions, and API keys captured by infostealers. The findings highlight that corporate AI platform accounts and API keys are increasingly targeted, representing a credential and session theft vector relevant to access management.

news.title: Enforce IAM permissions boundaries for Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio Tooling blueprints
news.summary: Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio has added support for custom IAM permissions boundaries for roles created by its Tooling blueprints. The feature allows administrators to restrict AI agent capabilities and configure boundaries via AWS CLI.

news.title: Agentic AI security pushes vendors toward shared safeguards
news.summary: Okta is advocating for coordinated, cross-industry security safeguards to address the trust and security challenges posed by agentic AI systems operating across multiple platforms. The discussion centers on how autonomous AI agents interacting between products require identity and access controls that go beyond individual vendor implementations.

news.title: New in Symfony 8.2: OpenID Connect Login
news.summary: Symfony 8.2 is introducing native OpenID Connect (OIDC) login support, allowing applications to delegate authentication to identity providers such as Keycloak, Auth0, Okta, and Microsoft Entra ID. This builds on OIDC token handler support added in Symfony 6.3, extending the framework's built-in federation capabilities.

news.title: Authorizer: Open-source authentication and authorization for your apps
news.summary: Authorizer is an open-source authentication and authorization server that organizations can self-host on their own infrastructure with a choice of database backend. The project includes a permissions engine, support for web and mobile apps, and has added an interface for AI agent integration.

news.title: Zero Trust for AI Agents Starts With Fixing Zero Visibility
news.summary: The article addresses the application of Zero Trust principles to AI agents, prompted by recent security incidents including an intrusion at Hugging Face during an OpenAI agent evaluation. The piece argues that organizations deploying AI agents face fundamental visibility and access control gaps that require IAM-focused solutions.

news.title: PamStealer macOS Malware Adds Live C2 Payload Decryption and Multi-Layer Persistence
news.summary: Cybersecurity researchers at Jamf Threat Labs identified a new version of PamStealer macOS malware that uses server-side decryption chains to protect its payload and employs multi-layer persistence mechanisms. The malware targets credential and session data on macOS systems using JavaScript for Automation (JXA) droppers with modified lures and delivery methods.

news.title: Vanderbilt University extends identity governance to AI agents
news.summary: Vanderbilt University is extending its identity governance framework to cover AI agents as they enter institutional workflows. The university uses OneVU, powered by Okta, as the foundation for managing these expanding identity relationships between people, institutions, and AI technology.

news.title: AWS IAM outbound identity federation now supports interface VPC endpoints for OIDC discovery
news.summary: AWS IAM outbound identity federation has added support for interface VPC endpoints for OIDC discovery APIs. This allows access to OIDC discovery metadata and JSON Web Key Set (JWKS) verification without requiring traffic to route over the public internet.

news.title: Ghost Service Accounts Enable M365 Data Theft in Chile
news.summary: A security incident in Chile involved attackers exploiting forgotten and unmanaged service accounts to steal data from Microsoft 365 environments. The attack highlights risks posed by orphaned or "ghost" service accounts that fall outside standard identity governance and access management controls.

news.title: FBI Probes Service Selling 153M+ Drivers Licenses
news.summary: A dark web service is selling digital scans of over 153 million U.S. and Canadian driver's licenses, apparently sourced from a Louisiana-based identity verification company. The FBI's New Orleans field office has opened an official inquiry into the breach, which affects identity verification infrastructure used across multiple organizations.

news.title: Canadian Man Pleads Guilty in Snowflake Extortions
news.summary: Canadian man Connor Riley Moucka pleaded guilty to computer fraud and conspiracy charges for hacking and extorting over 165 organizations using Snowflake cloud storage. The attacks involved unauthorized access to Snowflake customer accounts, affecting organizations including AT&T, from which over 100 million customer records were stolen.
